title: fix(app-shell): Studio's app preview resolves locale-map app, nav-item and group labels (objectui#11100)
body:
Fixes #11100

Clause-②: no

Studio's app preview now resolves the app label, each nav item's label and each group's label through the spec's `resolveI18nLabel` in the designer locale, the way the areas list in the same file already does. A label only decides an entry's text; it no longer decides whether the entry exists.

## What was wrong (measured on origin/main 76e9df06c, `AppPreview.tsx`)

- The header ran `String()` over the app label, so a locale-map label printed `[object Object]`.
- `normalizeNav` kept a label only when `typeof it.label === 'string'`, so a childless nav item with a map label was dropped together with its target.
- The same test made a map-labelled group fall to `(unnamed)`.

The spec types all three as `I18nLabel` (a plain string or a per-locale map): the `label` of every navigation branch except `separator`, and the app's own `label`.

## What changed

- `AppPreview.tsx`: the app label is `resolveI18nLabel(draft.label, locale) ?? appName`; `normalizeNav` takes the designer `locale` (threaded the way `unnamed` is) and resolves each item's and group's label with it. The header no longer calls `String()` on a label.
- An entry is dropped only when it has no label, no children and no target. `(unnamed)` now reads only for a label that is truly absent, or a map that resolves to nothing.
- New pin `AppPreview.labelMaps-11100.test.tsx` (7 tests) and one patch changeset for `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Behavior change to review

An entry that names a record (has a target) but carries no label used to vanish from the preview. It is now kept and reads `(unnamed)`, which is what the direction on the card rules ("a nav item is kept whenever it has a target"). An entry with no label, no children and no target is still dropped, as before. Nothing else about a plain-string label moves; the plain-string control is pinned.

## Evidence

- Before, pins against the unmodified file: `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)`.
- Reverse verification from the committed state: `git checkout` of `AppPreview.tsx` from the pinned base commit 76e9df06c (the `resolveI18nLabel(draft.label` anchor count 1 to 0, the `String(label)` anchor 0 to 1), then the pin file again: `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)` (direction: red, the two controls stay green). Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- FILE`; `git diff HEAD` empty and the HEAD blob hash equals the working-tree hash (5557011d1 at that step). The subject is imported by relative path from `src`, so no rebuild sits between the mutation and the run.
- After, at head cbe37f8b2:
  - `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/`: `Test Files 79 passed (79)`, `Tests 1057 passed (1057)`, 7 of them the new pin.
  - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`), after building its dependency closure with `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` (the upstream direction): exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` names the new test file, so the test project covers it.
  - `pnpm exec eslint` on both changed files: 0 errors, 7 warnings, all the `no-explicit-any` casts that were already in the file (the count is unchanged by this diff).
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs`, `pnpm run check:new-line-citations` (0 new citations), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`: all exit 0.

## Declared narrowing (CI owns the rest)

The repo-wide lint scan and the full test and check farm are CI's. The public surface is unchanged (`AppPreview`'s props, no new export; `normalizeNav` is module-private), so no downstream sweep is owed. The pins are the evidence; the browser gallery was not driven.

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope, measured, not fixed here: in design mode the nav is drawn by `AppNavCanvas`, whose own `navLabel` also tests `typeof label === 'string'`. Probe at this head: a draft with a nav item labelled as a locale map, rendered with `editing` in zh-CN, prints `Item 1` for that row while the landing line above it (this PR) prints the resolved `客户`. The canvas is a different file and an inline-rename editor, so it is reported for a separate card, not widened into this one.
- objectui#10862 (designer chrome strings in this file) stays serial behind this card and is not addressed here.
